definitions.explanation: The early part of the day, from dawn until around noon.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}、{何|なに}を{食|た}べましたか？
examples.english: What did you eat in the morning?

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}6{時|じ}に{起|お}きます。
examples.english: I wake up at 6 o'clock every morning.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}ごはんを{食|た}べましょう。

notes: A fundamental time word. Compounds: {朝|あさ}ごはん (breakfast), {毎朝|まいあさ} (every morning), {今朝|けさ} (this morning - irregular reading). Opposite: {夜|よる} (night).
